Overview

San Pedro Sula is a city in CR with a population of 800,000. Honduras’s industrial and economic powerhouse, a hot lowland city with a thriving manufacturing sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
